$comment: Asset roles packaged with the Echelon theme (EDS-ADR-002). Every source is an owner-approved mark in brand/logos/catalog.json; nothing here is drawn or altered. No separate favicon or startup artwork exists, so those roles reuse the approved square mark (mark.svg). tools/build_theme.py copies each source to its package path and records the sha256 in dist/asset-manifest.json.

roles.note: No separate favicon artwork exists; the approved square mark serves as the favicon.
No separate start-up (pre-WASM) artwork exists; the approved square mark serves the start-up screen.
